title: Work & colleagues
goal: Chat with colleagues, talk about projects and deadlines, ask your boss for leave, write a polite work email, read office notices and get through a job interview in Kannada.
intro:
Work in Bengaluru happens in two Kannadas at once. At the coffee machine colleagues say ಏನ್ ಮಚಾ, ಬ್ಯುಸಿನಾ? and mix in English for every work word: ಮೇಲ್, ಡೆಡ್‌ಲೈನ್, ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್. In front of the boss, in an interview, in an email to HR or at a government office, the same people switch to full, careful forms: ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ instead of ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ತಿಳಿಸಿ instead of ಹೇಳಿ.

This unit teaches both, and when to switch. The second grammar point is how Kannada says 'it was decided' or 'the meeting has been postponed' without naming who did it: casually with ಆಗು, formally with the **-ಲಾಗಿದೆ** passive you will see on every office notice.

vocab.note: Always with plural respect forms: ಬಾಸ್ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ 'the boss has come'.
ಟೀಮ್ ಲೀಡ್ 'team lead'.
Spoken locative ಕಂಪನೀಲಿ 'at the company'.
ಬ್ಯುಸಿ ಇದ್ದೀನಿ / ಬ್ಯುಸಿ ಆಗಿದ್ದೀನಿ 'I'm busy'.
Plural respect: ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
Transitive partner of ಮುಗಿ 'to get finished': ನಾನು ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿದೆ 'I finished the work' / ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗೀತು 'the work is done'.
Also ಇಮೇಲ್. ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳಿಸು / ಮೇಲ್ ಮಾಡು 'to email'.
The polite/formal word for 'tell': ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ತಿಳಿಸಿ 'please let me know'.
In speech people say ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡಿ or ಮೇಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
ಲೀವ್ ತಗೊ 'to take leave'. The Kannada word ರಜೆ (unit 7) is used too, especially for holidays.
ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಕು 'to apply'.
ಯಾವ ಕಾರಣಕ್ಕೆ? 'for what reason?'

vocab.en: Dear Sir / Madam (opening a formal letter)
vocab.note: Letters end with ಇಂತಿ ತಮ್ಮ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಿ 'Yours faithfully' and your name.
Formal/written for ಕೊಡು.
From ಒಪ್ಪು 'to agree'. ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಕೊಡು 'to approve'.
English loan: ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಮಾಡು 'to approve', ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಆಗು 'to get approved'.
ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಮಾಡು 'to decide'; verb ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸು (unit 17).
Formal: ಸಂದರ್ಶನ.
Work experience: ಐದು ವರ್ಷದ ಅನುಭವ 'five years' experience'. Also 'an experience' in life.
ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡು 'to choose', ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಆಗು 'to be selected'.

phrases.note: ಮಚಾ (also ಮಚ್ಚಾ, ಮಗಾ) is Bengaluru slang between guys of the same age. Never with seniors.

phrases.en: Shall we take a coffee break?
I've got loads of work today.
I'll finish it by this evening.
phrases.note: ಒಳಗೆ 'inside' after a time means 'by, within'. Formal: ಮುಗಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.
A standard closing line in emails and notices.

phrases.roman: nāḷe ondu dina līv bēku sār
phrases.en: Sir, I need a day's leave tomorrow.

phrases.note: Often shortened to ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯುಎಫ್‌ಹೆಚ್ (WFH) in messages.

Tell me a little about yourself. (interview)

grammar.title: Formal Kannada: full verb forms, ತಾವು, and the request ladder
grammar.body:
Kannada has a big gap between how you talk to a colleague at the coffee machine and how you write to HR or speak in a formal meeting. Spoken Bengaluru Kannada shortens verbs; formal Kannada (letters, emails, interviews, government offices, speeches, the news) uses the **full written forms**.

**Verb endings, spoken → formal:**
ನಾನು ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ → ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ 'I do / will do'
ನೀವು ಮಾಡ್ತೀರ → ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ
ಅವರು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ → ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ
ನಾವು ಮಾಡ್ತೀವಿ → ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ
ನಾನು ಇದ್ದೀನಿ → ಇದ್ದೇನೆ; ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀನಿ → ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ 'I have sent'
ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು → ಮಾಡಿದರು; ಆಯ್ತು → ಆಯಿತು; ಮಾಡ್ಬೇಕು → ಮಾಡಬೇಕು
The pattern: spoken **-ಈನಿ / -ಈವಿ** become **-ಏನೆ / -ಏವೆ**, and the swallowed vowels come back.

**Respect words.** Talk *about* any senior with the plural: ಬಾಸ್ ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ, ರಾವ್ ಸಾರ್ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು. Put **ಅವರು** after a name (ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರು; calling someone: ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರೇ!) or use ಸಾರ್ / ಮೇಡಂ. In writing, the most respectful 'you' is **ತಾವು** (ತಮ್ಮ 'your', ತಮಗೆ 'to you'): ತಮಗೆ ಸಮಯ ಇದ್ದರೆ 'if you have time'.

**The request ladder**, from casual to formal:
ಕೊಡು (friend) → ಕೊಡಿ (polite) → ಕೊಡ್ತೀರಾ? 'will you give?' (softer) → ಕೊಡಬಹುದಾ? 'could you / may I have?' → ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಕೊಡಿ (formal) → ನೀಡಬೇಕಾಗಿ ವಿನಂತಿ 'I request that you grant' (letters only).
Formal Kannada also swaps some everyday words: **ನೀಡು** for ಕೊಡು 'give', **ತಿಳಿಸು** 'inform' for ಹೇಳು, **ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸು** 'contact' for ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡು.

**A formal letter or email**: ಮಾನ್ಯರೇ, 'Dear Sir/Madam,' … ತಮ್ಮಲ್ಲಿ ವಿನಂತಿ 'I request you…' … ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಹಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು … ಇಂತಿ ತಮ್ಮ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಿ 'Yours faithfully'.

**In real Bengaluru offices** people mix: full forms and ಸಾರ್ for respect, English for work nouns: ಸಾರ್, ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ಚೆಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ. Over-formal Kannada with a friend sounds sarcastic, so switch back down at the coffee machine.

examples.en: I will finish this work tomorrow.

examples.native: ತಮಗೆ ಸಮಯ ಇದ್ದಾಗ ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ
examples.roman: tamage samaya iddāga dayaviṭṭu kare māḍi
examples.en: Please call when you have time.
Mr Rao is in a meeting.

examples.native: ಮಾನ್ಯರೇ, ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಮ್ಮ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ ತಿಳಿಸಿ
examples.roman: mānyarē, ī viṣayada bagge tamma abhiprāya tiḷisi
examples.en: Dear Sir/Madam, please let me know your opinion on this matter.
Sir, could you send me that file?

grammar.title: 'It was decided': passive and impersonal sentences
grammar.body:
Spoken Kannada rarely uses a true passive. To say what 'was done' without naming who did it, it has three tools, from casual to formal.

**1. ಆಗು instead of ಮಾಡು.** Many actions are a noun or an English word + ಮಾಡು 'do'. Swap ಮಾಡು for **ಆಗು** 'happen' and the doer disappears:
ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ ಲೀವ್ ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು 'the manager approved the leave' → ಲೀವ್ ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಆಯ್ತು 'the leave got approved'
ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು 'they decided' → ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಆಯ್ತು 'it was decided'
ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು 'they selected (me)' → ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಆದೆ 'I got selected'
Pairs of plain verbs work the same way: ಮುಗಿಸು 'finish (something)' / ಮುಗಿ 'get finished'; ಬದಲಾಯಿಸು 'change (something)' / ಬದಲಾಗು 'change, get changed'. The trap: if the sentence has a doer, it must be ಮಾಡು: ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರ್ ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ, not ಆಗಿಲ್ಲ.

**2. Just leave out the subject.** A 'they' verb with no subject means 'I was told / people say': ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು 'I was told there's no meeting'. Add ಅಂತೆ for office gossip: ಸಂಬಳ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರಂತೆ 'apparently salaries are going up'.

**3. The formal passive: infinitive + ಲಾಗು.** Notices, official emails, the news and announcements use the infinitive (ಮಾಡ, ತಿಳಿಸ, ಮುಂದೂಡ, ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸ) + forms of ಆಗು:
ಮಾಡಲಾಯಿತು 'was done'
ಮಾಡಲಾಗಿದೆ 'has been done'
ಮಾಡಲಾಗುವುದು 'will be done'
ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ 'is being done'
The object keeps its -ಅನ್ನು (ಸಭೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಂದೂಡಲಾಗಿದೆ 'the meeting has been postponed') and the verb agrees with nothing: ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು 'it was decided', ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ 'everyone has been informed'. A doer, if named, takes ಇಂದ or ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ: ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ 'from the client's side'.

Don't say -ಲಾಗಿದೆ to friends (you'll sound like a news reader), but you will read it on every notice board, bank SMS and office email.

examples.en: The work's done, let's go home now.
A holiday has been declared for the office tomorrow.
Everyone will be informed about the new rule.
A new manager has been chosen for the project.

dialogue.title: Monday morning in Whitefield
dialogue.setting: Priya gets to her office in Whitefield after a weekend away. Her colleague Suresh has news, and then there's a meeting with their manager, Mr Rao.

lines.speaker: Suresh
lines.en: Morning, Priya! How was the weekend?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.native: ಸೂಪರ್ ಆಗಿತ್ತು, ಮೈಸೂರಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದೆ. ಏನ್ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿ?
lines.roman: sūpar āgittu, maisūrige hōgidde. ēn suddi illi?
lines.en: Great, I went to Mysuru. What's new here?

lines.speaker: Suresh
lines.native: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಸುದ್ದಿ! ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್ ಡೆಡ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಶುಕ್ರವಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಂದೆ ತಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
lines.roman: doḍḍa suddi! klaiṇṭ ḍeḍlain shukravārakke munde tandiddāre.
lines.en: Big news! The client has brought the deadline forward to Friday.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.native: ಏನು?! ಇನ್ನೂ ಅರ್ಧ ಕೆಲಸ ಬಾಕಿ ಇದೆ.
lines.roman: ēnu?! innū ardha kelasa bāki ide.
lines.en: What?! Half the work is still left.

lines.speaker: Suresh
lines.native: ಅದಕ್ಕೇ ಹತ್ತು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ರಾವ್ ಸಾರ್ ಮೂಡ್ ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಹುಷಾರು!
lines.roman: adakkē hattu gaṇṭege mīṭiṅg iṭṭiddāre. rāv sār mūḍ sari illa, huṣāru!
lines.en: That's why there's a meeting at ten. Rao sir's in a bad mood, careful!

lines.speaker: Mr Rao
lines.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ. ಕ್ಲೈಂಟ್ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಡೆಡ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಶುಕ್ರವಾರದೊಳಗೆ ಮೊದಲ ಭಾಗ ಕೊಡಬೇಕು.
lines.roman: namaskāra. klaiṇṭ kaḍeyinda ḍeḍlain badalāyisalāgide. shukravāradoḷage modala bhāga koḍabēku.
lines.en: Good morning. The deadline has been changed by the client. We have to deliver the first part by Friday.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.native: ಸಾರ್, ನನ್ನ ಭಾಗ ಗುರುವಾರ ಸಂಜೆ ಒಳಗೆ ಮುಗಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ. ಆದರೆ ಟೆಸ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರು ಬೇಕು.
lines.roman: sār, nanna bhāga guruvāra sañje oḷage mugisuttēne. ādare ṭesṭiṅge innobbaru bēku.
lines.en: Sir, I'll finish my part by Thursday evening. But we need one more person for testing.

lines.speaker: Mr Rao
lines.native: ಸರಿ, ಸುರೇಶ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಇನ್ನೇನಾದ್ರೂ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಇದ್ರೆ ನನಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿ.
lines.roman: sari, surēsh nimma jote kelasa māḍtāre. innēnādrū samasye idre nanage tiḷisi.
lines.en: All right, Suresh will work with you. If there's any other problem, let me know.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.native: ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯ ಸಾರ್... ಶುಕ್ರವಾರ ಲೀವ್ ತಗೋಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಇದ್ದೆ. ನನ್ನ ತಂಗಿಯ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತಾರ್ಥ.
lines.roman: ondu viṣaya sār... shukravāra līv tagōbēku anta idde. nanna taṅgiya nishchitārtha.
lines.en: One thing, sir... I was planning to take Friday off. It's my sister's engagement.

lines.speaker: Mr Rao
lines.native: ಓಹ್, ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಗುರುವಾರದೊಳಗೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದ್ರೆ ಲೀವ್ ತಗೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಕಿ, ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
lines.roman: ōh, paravāgilla. guruvāradoḷage kelasa mugidre līv tagoḷḷi. arji hāki, aprūv māḍtīni.
lines.en: Oh, no problem. If the work is done by Thursday, take the day. Put in an application and I'll approve it.

lines.speaker: Suresh
lines.native: ನೋಡಿದ್ಯಾ? ಮೂಡ್ ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದ್ರೂ ಲೀವ್ ಕೊಟ್ರು! ಪಾರ್ಟಿ ಕೊಡಬೇಕು ನೀನು.
lines.roman: nōḍidyā? mūḍ sari illa andrū līv koṭru! pārṭi koḍabēku nīnu.
lines.en: See? Bad mood and all, he still gave you the day off! You owe us a party.

culture:
Bengaluru's offices, especially in tech, run on a mix of English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu, and many colleagues won't be Kannadigas. English is the default for work itself, so a colleague who hears you use Kannada will usually be delighted, and Kannada small talk (ಊಟ ಆಯ್ತಾ?, ಏನ್ ಮಚಾ?) builds friendships fast.

Hierarchy shows in language even when an office looks casual. Seniors are ಸಾರ್ / ಮೇಡಂ or name + ಅವರು, and are always referred to in the plural (ಬಾಸ್ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಾರೆ). Startups use first names, but the plural verb stays. Slang like ಮಚಾ, ಮಗಾ and ಗುರು is for friends and peers your own age, mostly between men.

Government offices, banks and anything official in Karnataka work in formal Kannada: notices use the -ಲಾಗಿದೆ passive, letters begin with ಮಾನ್ಯರೇ and end with ಇಂತಿ ತಮ್ಮ ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಿ. Asking for leave usually comes with a reason (family function, a parent unwell, a trip home to your ಊರು), and good news at work (a promotion, a new job, an appraisal) is expected to be celebrated with a treat for the team.

tip.title: Colleagues: friendly but careful
tip.body:
- Peers your age: **ನೀನು** forms and slang like **ಮಚಾ** / **ಗುರು** 'mate'.
- Seniors and anyone older: **ನೀವು** forms, ಸಾರ್ / ಮೇಡಂ, or name + **ಅವರು**.
- Talking *about* a senior: always plural: ಬಾಸ್ **ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ**, not ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾನೆ.

sentences.en: Hey mate, you're in early today?

sentences.native: ಬಾಸ್ ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಂದಿಲ್ಲ, ಆರಾಮಾಗಿ ಕಾಫಿ ಕುಡಿ.
sentences.roman: bās innū bandilla, ārāmāgi kāphi kuḍi.
sentences.en: The boss isn't in yet, relax and drink your coffee.
The boss is in meetings today.
There are ten of us in our team.
Which company do you work at? (informal)
Ramesh, do you have a minute? (polite)
No mate, really busy today.
Coming for lunch, mate?
Ma'am, would you like a coffee?

sentences.native: ಬಾಸ್ ಮೂಡ್ ಇವತ್ತು ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಹುಷಾರು!
sentences.roman: bās mūḍ ivattu sari illa, huṣāru!
sentences.en: The boss is in a bad mood today, watch out!

tip.title: By when? time + ಒಳಗೆ
tip.body:
- **By** a time = time + **ಒಳಗೆ** 'inside, within': ಸಂಜೆ **ಒಳಗೆ** 'by evening'.
- It fuses after -ದ: ಶುಕ್ರವಾರ**ದೊಳಗೆ** 'by Friday', ಎರಡು ದಿನ**ದೊಳಗೆ** 'within two days'.
- **ಮುಗಿ** = it gets finished, **ಮುಗಿಸು** = you finish it: ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗೀತು / ನಾನು ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸಿದೆ.

sentences.en: This project has to be finished by Friday.
The client has changed the deadline.
I'll finish it and send it within two days.

sentences.native: ಕೆಲಸ ಇನ್ನೂ ಮುಗಿದಿಲ್ಲ, ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಗಂಟೆ ಬೇಕು.
sentences.roman: kelasa innū mugidilla, innondu gaṇṭe bēku.
sentences.en: The work isn't done yet, I need another hour.
I've finished my bit, what about you?
This client is your responsibility.

sentences.native: ಮೀಟಿಂಗ್ ಹನ್ನೊಂದು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ, ಹತ್ತೂವರೆ ಒಳಗೆ ರೆಡಿ ಆಗಿರಿ.
sentences.roman: mīṭiṅg hannondu gaṇṭege, hattūvare oḷage reḍi āgiri.
sentences.en: The meeting's at eleven, be ready by half past ten.

sentences.native: ಡೆಡ್‌ಲೈನ್ ನಾಳೆನಾ? ಅಯ್ಯೋ, ಇವತ್ತು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕೂತು ಮುಗಿಸಬೇಕು.
sentences.roman: ḍeḍlain nāḷenā? ayyō, ivattu rātri kūtu mugisabēku.
sentences.en: The deadline's tomorrow? Oh no, I'll have to sit up tonight and finish it.
Will it be done by this evening?

tip.title: Formal Kannada: full forms
tip.body:
- In emails, interviews and formal meetings, use the full forms: ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ → **ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ**, ಇದ್ದೀನಿ → **ಇದ್ದೇನೆ**, ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀನಿ → **ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ**.
- Requests: **ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು** + the -ಇ form: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ತಿಳಿಸಿ.
- The most respectful written 'you': **ತಾವು**, ತಮ್ಮ, **ತಮಗೆ**.

sentences.en: Sir, I have sent that email.
Please look at the email and let me know.
For more information, please contact me.
I will come at ten tomorrow morning.

sentences.native: ತಮಗೆ ಸಮಯ ಇದ್ದರೆ ನಾಳೆ ಭೇಟಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾ?
sentences.roman: tamage samaya iddare nāḷe bhēṭi māḍabahudā?
sentences.en: If you have time, may I meet you tomorrow?
I'll let you know as soon as I have the information.

sentences.native: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಹಕಾರ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಇದು ಸಾಧ್ಯ ಆಗ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
sentences.roman: nimma sahakāra illade idu sādhya āgtiralilla.
sentences.en: This wouldn't have been possible without your support.

sentences.native: ಸಾರಿ ಸಾರ್, ಮೇಲ್ ಕಳಿಸೋಕೆ ಮರೆತು ಹೋಯ್ತು.
sentences.roman: sāri sār, mēl kaḷisōke maretu hōytu.
sentences.en: Sorry sir, I forgot to send the email.
Apologies for the late reply.

lessons.title: Asking for leave

tip.title: Asking, from casual to formal
tip.body:
- ಕೊಡು (friend) → **ಕೊಡಿ** (polite) → **ಕೊಡ್ತೀರಾ?** (softer) → **ಕೊಡಬಹುದಾ?** 'could you / may I'.
- 'May I…?' = verb + **-ಬಹುದಾ?**: ಲೀವ್ ತಗೋ**ಬಹುದಾ**?
- In a letter: **ಮಾನ್ಯರೇ,** … ರಜೆ **ನೀಡಬೇಕಾಗಿ ವಿನಂತಿ** 'I request that you grant leave'.

new: ನಾಳೆ ಒಂದು ದಿನ ಲೀವ್ ಬೇಕು ಸಾರ್

sentences.en: Sir, can I take Friday off?
What do you need leave for?

sentences.native: ಅಮ್ಮನಿಗೆ ಹುಷಾರಿಲ್ಲ, ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಲೀವ್ ಕೊಡ್ತೀರಾ?
sentences.roman: ammanige huṣārilla, eraḍu dina līv koḍtīrā?
sentences.en: My mother's not well, could you give me two days' leave?

sentences.native: ಲೀವ್‌ಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಕಿ, ನಾನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಕೊಡ್ತೀನಿ.
sentences.roman: līvge arji hāki, nānu oppige koḍtīni.
sentences.en: Apply for leave and I'll approve it.

sentences.native: ಮಾನ್ಯರೇ, ನನಗೆ ಎರಡು ದಿನ ರಜೆ ನೀಡಬೇಕಾಗಿ ವಿನಂತಿ.
sentences.roman: mānyarē, nanage eraḍu dina raje nīḍabēkāgi vinanti.
sentences.en: Dear Sir/Madam, I request two days' leave.
Don't take leave without your manager's permission.
Could I leave a bit early tomorrow, sir?

sentences.native: ನಾಳೆ ವರ್ಕ್ ಫ್ರಮ್ ಹೋಮ್, ಏನಾದ್ರೂ ಬೇಕಾದ್ರೆ ಫೋನ್ ಮಾಡಿ.
sentences.roman: nāḷe vark phram hōm, ēnādrū bēkādre phōn māḍi.
sentences.en: I'm working from home tomorrow, call me if you need anything.

sentences.native: ಕಾರಣ ಹೇಳದೆ ಲೀವ್ ತಗೊಂಡ್ರೆ ಬಾಸ್‌ಗೆ ಕೋಪ ಬರುತ್ತೆ.
sentences.roman: kāraṇa hēḷade līv tagoṇḍre bāsge kōpa barutte.
sentences.en: If you take leave without giving a reason, the boss gets angry.
Did your leave get approved?

tip.title: It was done: ಆಗು and -ಲಾಗಿದೆ
tip.body:
- Everyday: swap **ಮಾಡು** for **ಆಗು** and the doer disappears: ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ರು 'they approved' → ಅಪ್ರೂವ್ **ಆಯ್ತು** 'it got approved'.
- Notices and emails: infinitive + **-ಲಾಗಿದೆ** 'has been', **-ಲಾಯಿತು** 'was', **-ಲಾಗುವುದು** 'will be'.
- Or leave out 'they': ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು 'I was told'.

sentences.en: My leave got approved!
The manager hasn't approved it yet.
The meeting has been postponed to Monday.
It's been decided that we're moving to the new office.

sentences.native: ಮುಂದಿನ ತಿಂಗಳಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ವಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಮೂರು ದಿನ ಆಫೀಸಿಗೆ ಬರಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
sentences.roman: mundina tiṅgaḷinda ellarū vārakke mūru dina āphīsige barabēku anta nirdharisalāyitu.
sentences.en: It was decided that from next month everyone must come to the office three days a week.
A notice has been sent to everyone.
Apparently there's no meeting, I was just told.
Wait until instructions come through.
The decision is up to you.
The work will be completed on time.

sentences.native: ನಾಳೆ ನನಗೆ ಇಂಟರ್ವ್ಯೂ ಇದೆ, ಟೆನ್ಶನ್ ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ.
sentences.roman: nāḷe nanage iṇṭarvyū ide, ṭenshan āgtide.
sentences.en: I've got an interview tomorrow, I'm nervous.
Which position have you applied for?
I have five years' experience.

sentences.native: ನೀವು ಈ ಕಂಪನಿ ಯಾಕೆ ಸೇರಬೇಕು ಅಂತ ಇದ್ದೀರ?
sentences.roman: nīvu ī kampani yāke sērabēku anta iddīra?
sentences.en: Why do you want to join this company?
Why did you leave your last company?
You've been selected, congratulations!

sentences.native: ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಆದ್ರೆ ಒಂದು ವಾರದೊಳಗೆ ಮೇಲ್ ಬರುತ್ತೆ.
sentences.roman: āyke ādre ondu vāradoḷage mēl barutte.
sentences.en: If you're selected, you'll get an email within a week.
What salary are you expecting?
How did the interview go? It went well, let's see.
